product_notes.ABC/3TC: Placeholder row 28 retained as registrational assignment: Epzicom label (2009 SPL) states 'There have been no clinical trials conducted with EPZICOM' (approval via bioequivalence + component trial CNA30021). Post-approval Phase 3 trials where the ABC/3TC backbone is evaluated added as new records (existing_row null): ACTG A5202, ESS30008 (SEAL), CAL30001. Excluded: HEAT and ASSERT (Phase 4 per CT.gov), ALOHA (safety primary), GS-US-311-1717 (ABC/3TC comparator only). Approval year 2004 NOT verifiable on DailyMed (no 'Initial U.S. Approval' in available Epzicom SPLs). Not screened: NCT01900106 (ABC/3TC late presenters), NCT00318123 (ABC+3TC+EFV vs LPV/r), KLEAN/ARIES/other anchor-drug trials (ABC/3TC background).
product_notes.TAF/FTC: Placeholder row 29 (no standalone registrational trial; Descovy label sec 14 relies on Genvoya trials 104/111/109 etc.). Post-approval Phase 3 F/TAF backbone switch trials added (existing_row null): GS-US-311-1089 (NCT02121795), GS-US-311-1717 (NCT02469246). Descovy label Highlights 'Initial U.S. Approval: 2015' vs master 2016 - flagged for human decision (no change logged because placeholder row not overwritten).
product_notes.TDF/FTC: Placeholder row 30 not overwritten, but Study 934 (NCT00112047) is the Truvada label sec 14.2 trial and qualifies (FTC+TDF co-administered, comparator AZT/3TC) - added with existing_row null; human to decide whether to replace placeholder. ACTG A5202 also added. Excluded: HEAT/ASSERT (Phase 4), SWEET (haemoglobin primary), GS-US-311-1089 (F/TDF comparator only). Approval 2004 confirmed (Truvada label). Not screened: other anchor-drug trials with Truvada as background (not in scope).
product_notes.TDF/3TC: Placeholder row 31 retained. Cimduo label sec 14.1 cites only Trial 903 (TDF vs d4T with 3TC in both arms) - TDF/3TC pair not the evaluated contrast; no Phase 3 adult treatment trial found where TDF/3TC is the investigational backbone (ctsearch lamivudine; PubMed). Approval 2018 confirmed (Cimduo label Highlights). Temixys: no DailyMed SPL found.
product_notes.ABC: 3 records: CNA30024 (row 32; publication corrected - previous title described CNA30021), CNA3005, CNA30021. Approval 1998 confirmed (Ziagen label). Not screened (time): CNA3003 (ABC+3TC/ZDV vs 3TC/ZDV), Hammer 2010 ABC intensification (PMID 21239359; phase not checked), NCT00338390 and NCT01153217 (TDF->ABC switch, BMD/CD4 primaries), CNA3014 (Vibhagool 2004, open-label; phase not checked), Clumeck 2001 simplification (PMID 11504984).
product_notes.FTC: 3 records: FTC-301A (row 33; NCT00006208 added), FTC-303 (NCT00002416, Phase 3 per CT.gov), Study 934. Approval 2003 confirmed (Emtriva label). Excluded NCT00002362 (suspended, no results). FTC-302 (FTC vs 3TC, South Africa) not screened - no CT.gov/PubMed hit found quickly; human to check.
product_notes.ISL: Placeholder row 34 kept (user decision): islatravir has no standalone FDA HIV approval; ISL Phase 3 trials are covered under DOR/ISL in another group. No extraction performed.
product_notes.3TC: 6 records: NUCA3001 (row 35), NUCA3002, NUCB3001, NUCB3002, CAESAR (NUCB3007), EPV20001. Approval 1995 confirmed (Epivir label). Pre-2000 trials: phase not stated in abstracts; NUCA/NUCB trial-code mapping to publications not stated in abstracts (flagged). Not screened: NUCA3005/NUCB3005 (clinical endpoint), other early 3TC studies.
product_notes.TAF: Placeholder row 36 kept (user decision): no standalone TAF HIV product; single-agent Vemlidy (Initial U.S. Approval 2015 per label) is indicated for chronic HBV only. TAF HIV evidence is via coformulations (Genvoya, Descovy, Odefsey, Biktarvy, Symtuza). No extraction performed.
product_notes.TDF: 3 records: Study 903 (row 37; NCT00158821 added per Viread label - CT.gov enrollment 180 discrepancy flagged), Study 934, Study 907 (NCT00002450). Approval 2001 confirmed (Viread label). Study 902 excluded (Phase 2). Not screened: Moyle 2006 TDF vs ABC replacement for lipoatrophy (RAVE; phase not checked), other post-approval TDF switch trials.
